description: Requirements verified by the automated tests. Each test declares the requirement it verifies with [Property("Requirement", "ID")]. The requirements matrix starts from this list, so a requirement without tests is reported as not covered.

requirements.title: The points of a star are 1000 scaled by the time factor and by the accuracy.
After 3 consecutive missed stars the game gets easier by one step; after 5 consecutive collected stars it moves back by one step towards the base values.
The bones of the character rig are mapped to their roles by name, ignoring case.
Score inputs: elapsed time zero or more, accuracy from 0 to 1, values that are not finite numbers rejected.
Input conversion: unit direction, speed from 0 to 1, invalid samples produce no movement.
The leaderboard stores the score with the same player, match and score as the entry sent.
The leaderboard accepts one score per player and match.
The leaderboard returns the best scores highest first, at most the requested count, and honors cancellation.
The difficulty never goes below the minimum values or above the base values.
A bone missing from the character rig is reported and the rig is marked as incomplete.
Loading a scene of the build does not log unexpected errors or exceptions.
